Routing strategy proposed: latency-sensitive traffic -> dedicated pool with KV cache enabled; lower-priority batch reranks -> spot/shared pool
SLA negotiation points: define p95 SLO per-route, credits for degraded latency, and explicit fallback behavior to hosted model with data residency guarantees
